name: offset-listener
features: Listen identifies the playing song by microphone and calculates the playback offset.
Search finds a track, and play and broadcast shares a sync anchor so other phones play in step.
Nudge buttons shift the offset by half a second either way.
Watch in sync, measure sync by mic and save cue points work.
Enable audio unlocks playback on phones, and an info panel explains the build status.
overlap: Shares its sync engine with scope-listener and phasewell-scope. Merge candidate.
